title: Keep or revert one change
goal: Compare the same test before and after one edit, then check the result against a numeric goal.
live_equivalent: before/after are two falcon_native_render results with identical notes, separated by one falcon_native_edit (example 07).

steps.why: Ranked feature differences say what the edit changed; compare only renders of the identical test.
State the goal as numbers; the evaluation says whether it is met and which way to move.

conclusion: The edit made the note brighter, from a centroid near 300 Hz to near 580 Hz, overshooting the 350-450 Hz goal: keep the direction, back the change off, render the same test and diff again. Attack is unaffected.
